title: Lumen
subtitle: A single line of diamond light, resting where the collarbone meets the throat.
description: A pendant reduced to its essentials — round brilliants set in eighteen-karat white gold, arranged so the light reads as one continuous gesture rather than a cluster of individual stones. Nothing is added for ornament; the design lives entirely in proportion and placement, in how the piece catches the light as the wearer moves and returns it in clean, unhurried flashes. It sits quietly at the throat, made to be worn every day and noticed slowly.
